verdict.rationale: Vast.ai ships an official CLI (`vastai` on PyPI, vast-ai/vast-cli repo) that its docs say covers the entire platform: authentication, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes and serverless. It adds AI-native touches such as scoped API keys for automation and an agent skill built on the CLI. A hands-on runtime probe confirmed the CLI installs, prints its full command surface, and searches the live marketplace without a key.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Vast.ai CLI gives you command-line access to the entire platform, authentication, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless endpoints, and more.
Anything you can do in the web console, you can automate from your terminal.
the official Vast.ai CLI (pypi `vastai`) installed via uvx and ran keylessly — `vastai --help` prints the full command surface including search offers, create instance, and destroy instance.
Provides both the CLI and SDK for managing Vast.ai GPU cloud resources, plus a serverless client for endpoint inference.
Install the skill into your coding agent with one command: npx skills add vast-ai/vast-cli --skill vastai
